about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, who is preparing to launch a new hotel in St Julian's, for an experienced and hands-on Hotel General Manager. You will lead the pre-opening preparations and then oversee the hotel's operations once it opens.

The property will have approximately 60 guest rooms in the 3-star segment and is planned to open in June 2027, subject to project readiness. Reporting directly to the Directors, you will take ownership of the hotel's setup — the opening plan, organisational structure, recruitment and training, procedures, suppliers, systems, rates and distribution, licensing and compliance — and then of its day-to-day performance: guest experience, budgets and forecasts, occupancy, ADR and RevPAR, team development and commercial relationships.

It suits a motivated hotel leader who enjoys building operations from the ground up. The role offers a gross annual salary of €52,000–€55,000 depending on experience and suitability, a performance-related bonus of up to 10–15% of gross annual basic salary, and a company-paid mobile phone. The joining date will be agreed with the successful applicant, sufficiently in advance of the opening.

faq: What does the Hotel General Manager job pay?
A gross annual salary of €52,000–€55,000 depending on experience and suitability, plus a performance-related bonus of up to 10–15% of gross annual basic salary and a company-paid mobile phone.

The hotel is expected to open in June 2027, subject to project readiness. The successful candidate will join sufficiently in advance to lead the pre-opening; the joining date is agreed with the applicant.
It will have approximately 60 guest rooms and operate in the 3-star hotel segment in St Julian's.
Who does the General Manager report to?
The role reports directly to the Directors, with regular performance updates on challenges and opportunities.
It is not required, but previous hotel pre-opening experience is considered a strong advantage. Senior hotel management experience is required.
Do I need to speak Maltese?
No. Fluent spoken and written English is required; knowledge of Maltese or other languages is an advantage.
